Countervailing factors include 'Concerns about Weak Global Demand and Oversupply' and 'EIA Reports Brent Crude Oil Prices Averaged [CURRENT_VALUE_REQUIRED] Less in [CURRENT_PERIOD_REQUIRED]'.
